observed_facts: CNA 2025-01-16 (updated 2025-01-26) reports TSMC management's 2024 AI accelerator revenue share near 15%, 2025 AI accelerator revenue expected to double, 2024-2029 AI accelerator revenue CAGR near 45%, and company USD revenue CAGR near 20%.
2025 capex USD38–42bn and 2025 USD revenue growth 24–26% are already present in TSMC original Jan16 release; this CNA item is secondary corroboration, not independent new capex guidance.
AI accelerator platform revenue is a subset of TSMC total revenue; do not add to HPC or CoWoS as incremental standalone revenue.
publisher: CNA Taiwan; attributed to TSMC management earnings call
